The Yelp search landscape is overwhelmingly negative, dominated by a single, credible-sounding complaint about product failure and refusal to stand behind the work. The lack of any countervailing positive reviews on Yelp, combined with the specific details of the complaint, suggests a potentially serious issue with product durability and customer service follow-through. The authenticity of the positive Google reviews cannot be verified with the provided data.
